clauses: Count only observatories that have at least one telescope, taking the average share over those observatories.
Count all rows in the observatories table as observatories, including those with zero telescopes, when averaging shares.
Measure how far above the average as the plain difference between share and average share, not a ratio or percentage.
readings: For each observatory (`observstation` in the telescopes table), count its telescopes and work out its share of all telescopes. Then, taking only the observatories whose share is above the average share across all observatories, give a single summary row: their average telescope count, their average share, and how far on average their share sits above the average share. Don't round anything. Count only observatories that have at least one telescope, taking the average share over those observatories.

For each observatory (`observstation` in the telescopes table), count its telescopes and work out its share of all telescopes. Then, taking only the observatories whose share is above the average share across all observatories, give a single summary row: their average telescope count, their average share, and how far on average their share sits above the average share. queries:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt,
         COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM counts
)
SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_telescope_count,
       AVG(share) AS avg_share,
       AVG(share - (SELECT a FROM avg_share)) AS avg_excess_over_average_share
FROM counts
WHERE share > (SELECT a FROM avg_share);
WITH c AS (
  SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS cnt
  FROM observatories o
  LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation
),
s AS (
  SELECT observstation, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share
  FROM c
),
a AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s
)
SELECT AVG(s.cnt) AS avg_telescope_count,
       AVG(s.share) AS avg_share,
       AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_share_above_average
FROM s, a
WHERE s.share > a.avg_share;
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
shares AS (
  SELECT observstation, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share
  FROM counts
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_s FROM shares
)
SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_telescope_count,
       AVG(share) AS avg_share,
       AVG(share - (SELECT avg_s FROM avg_share)) AS avg_share_above_average
FROM shares
WHERE share > (SELECT avg_s FROM avg_share);
